objective: Specialize Pang v2 at degree two over F2 for the checked syntactic rules, probability model and DAG-node count, and establish what is genuinely added relative to affine proof lines.
status: Admitted, conditional: Pang v2 Theorem 7.2(a) at degree two and characteristic two gives an exponential proof-node lower bound with high probability for 8n random strict ternary clauses. A quadratic line can express a relation no affine disjunction expresses, and checking unrestricted semantic weakening on such lines is coNP-complete. (Narrowed 2026-11-16, referee GUARDED-ROUTE-BRANCH-R1: conditional on Pang's unrefereed, AI-assisted preprint, assumption A84.)
title: Source theorem for degree-two polynomial resolution on random strict ternary CNF
